tools.name: search_prompts
tools.title: Search prompt library
tools.description: Search Depikt's public library of production-grade ChatGPT image prompts by keyword and/or category. Returns matching prompts with their full prompt text.

query.description: Keywords to match against prompt title, body and tags. Omit to browse.

category.description: Category filter, e.g. Posters, Infographics, UI Mockups, Cinematic.

tools.name: get_prompt
tools.title: Get a prompt
tools.description: Fetch one prompt from Depikt's public library by its id or slug, including the full prompt text and why it works.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.title: List prompt templates
tools.description: List Depikt's prompt templates — reusable prompt formulas, each answering one question with a copy-ready prompt and an explanation of why it works.

slug.description: Return only the template with this slug.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.title: Read a Depikt guide
tools.description: List Depikt's published prompting guides, or read the full text of one guide by slug. Covers prompt structure, text rendering, infographics, UI mockups, product shots and more.

slug.description: Slug of the guide to read in full. Omit to list all available guides.
